Rifle Paper Co., founded in Winter Park, is celbrating its grand opening in Hyde Park […] The post Long-awaited stationery boutique Rifle Paper Co. sets debut in Hyde Park Village appeared first on That's So Tampa. After six months anticipation, a popular Central Florida boutique is making its debut in Tampa. Rifle Paper Co., founded in Winter Park, is celbrating its grand opening in Hyde Park Village this weekend, with the new shop located at 714 S Village Circle. Run by husband-and-wife team Nathan and Anna Bond, Rifle Paper Co. started as a small stationery brand based on Anna’s floral art designs. In the 16 years since opening, it has blossomed and grown to include a full line of home decor, accessories, apparel, gifts and more. To celebrate its Tampa debut, Rifle Paper Co. will host a grand opening event on Saturday, November 7, from 10 am to 7 pm, complete with a large-scale floral installation and several outdoor activations taking place around the iconic Village Circle Fountain. ADVERTISEMENT (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}); Specially designed for the store, the brand will debut a new collection of Tampa-exclusive products at the grand opening celebration, featuring hand-illustrated artwork including nods to Florida such as pirate ships, alligators, and seashells. The first 400 guests will receive a free tote bag, screen printed live on-site, and free popsicles by Hyppo Gourmet Ice Pops. Additional activities include a free vintage photo booth and DIY bouquets from Posies Flower Truck. Rooted in Anna’s original artwork, the brand is known for bold colors, hand-painted florals, and thoughtful design. The new Hyde Park Village boutique will be the second-ever location for Rifle Paper Co. The 2,700-square-foot boutique in Tampa will offer customers an opportunity to experience Rifle Paper Co.’s expansive collection in person, including stationery, gifts, exclusive products, and seasonal collections. “I am so happy that we are finally ready to open our doors in Tampa.
